usages.explain: Used when the speaker suggests doing something on their own initiative, often proposing something beneficial for the other party.

examples.content: 私が駅まで乗せてもいい。
examples.transcription: わたしがえきまでのせてもいい。
examples.mean: I can give you a ride to the station.

examples.content: この任務は私が担当してもいい。
examples.transcription: このにんむはわたしがたんとうしてもいい。
examples.mean: I can take charge of this task.

title: てもいい => is OK to ~; is alright to ~; may I ~?
